points.display: I rise in support of H.R. 5408, the Faster Labor Contracts Act, which ensures that workers can quickly and efficiently reach a first contract between a union and their employer.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5408, the Faster Labor 
Contracts Act, which ensures that workers can quickly and efficiently 
reach a first contract between a union and their employer.
points.speaker: Robert C. "Bobby" Scott

points.display: I thank Mr. Scott for yielding. Mr. Speaker, when a union wins more fair pay and better working conditions for its members, it sets the bar higher for everyone.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I thank Mr. Scott for yielding.
  Mr. Speaker, when a union wins more fair pay and better working 
conditions for its members, it sets the bar higher for everyone.
points.speaker: Donald Norcross

points.display: I thank the distinguished ranking member for yielding. Mr. Speaker, I rise as a son of the labor movement and co-chair of the Congressional Labor Caucus in strong support of the Faster Labor Contracts Act.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I thank the distinguished ranking member 
for yielding.
  Mr. Speaker, I rise as a son of the labor movement and co-chair of 
the Congressional Labor Caucus in strong support of the Faster Labor 
Contracts Act.
points.speaker: Steven Horsford

points.display: I rise in opposition to H.R. 5408, the so-called Faster Labor Contracts Act.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to H.R. 5408, the so-called Faster 
Labor Contracts Act.
points.speaker: Tim Walberg

points.display: I thank the chairman for yielding the time. Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to H.R. 5408, the Faster Labor Contracts Act.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I thank the chairman for yielding the time.
  Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to H.R. 5408, the Faster 
Labor Contracts Act.
points.speaker: Rick W. Allen

points.display: I rise today in strong opposition to the so- called Faster Labor Contracts Act.
points.quote:
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to the so-
called Faster Labor Contracts Act.
points.speaker: Randy Fine
